summary: A private installation's web app now answers from your own network.

fixes.title: Private web app answers from your network
fixes.text: On a network SecurityInsight creates, the web app of a private installation now answers people on your own network.
fixes.action: On a network you provide, have your network team take the network step the install names.

fixes.title: Two editions never share a resource group
fixes.text: When the resource group already holds the other SecurityInsight edition, the install stops before creating anything and asks you for another name.
